statement: Employee share scheme amounts otherwise assessed on grant are reduced under the start-up concession where no equity interests of the company, its subsidiaries, or its holding companies are listed on an approved stock exchange, every company in the group has been incorporated for less than 10 years, the company's aggregated turnover does not exceed $50 million, and the share discount is no more than 15% of market value or the option's strike price is at least the market value of the underlying share.
caveat: The further conditions in section 83A-45 (including employment, the 10% ownership ceiling, and minimum holding periods) and, for shares, the broad-availability condition in subsection 83A-105(2) must also be met; the concession shifts taxation to the capital gains rules on disposal.
